decisions.briefing: Markets traded flat today (NASDAQ -0.0%, S&P 500 -0.2%) with no clear directional signal. Cash is only $89.29, well below the $500 threshold needed to fund a new position, so we're holding all 7 existing positions rather than forcing a trade.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices were essentially flat today, with the S&P 500 slipping a modest 0.2% and the Nasdaq roughly unchanged. There was no dominant catalyst driving broad market direction, consistent with a low-conviction, wait-and-see session. Without a clear trend, it's a day for holding steady rather than chasing new positions.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢平淡,標普500指數微跌0.2%,納斯達克指數幾乎持平。市場缺乏明顯的推動因素,呈現觀望氣氛,投資人傾向按兵不動而非追高。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" means keeping cash on hand instead of investing it all, so you have flexibility to act when a strong opportunity appears. Today, with only $89 in cash and a neutral market, it's better to preserve that flexibility than force a trade just to stay fully invested.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」(Dry Powder)指的是保留現金而非全數投入市場,以便在出現絕佳機會時能靈活出手。今日現金僅剩89美元且市場中性,與其為了投入資金而勉強交易,不如保留彈性,等待更明確的進場訊號。
